artworks.label: Mosswood storybook
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for mosswick. One tiny closed woodland storybook with a beautifully textured cork-bark cover, inlaid soft green moss fern motif, thick warm-ivory deckled paper pages, small tan stitched spine and simple unlettered wood clasp, one tiny moss tuft at the lower corner. Sophisticated handcrafted cork/felt miniature, warm cozy craft photography, visible natural cork grain and fuzzy moss, sage/cork-brown/cream palette. No writing, letters, numbers, animals, snail, tower, cottage or cart. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
